Adapted E8 matrix, lower-triangular determinant certificate, and real basis construction from Sphere-Packing-Lean.
Source: https://github.com/math-inc/Sphere-Packing-Lean/blob/1e98fb493088948ca7bbf47d7faed49cc5b39fc4/SpherePacking/Dim8/E8/Basic.lean

Modified: specialized names and field to this project and real scalars; continuous coordinate map added. E8Parity.lean adapts the concrete inverse-coordinate formulas and proves the integer/half-integer, even-sum equivalence using explicit integer witnesses. The whole library and generic submodule infrastructure were not imported.

The Gaussian-domination proof architecture in Riesz/E8ThetaSummable.lean was
adapted from the same pinned repository's rank-24 ThetaAnalytic.lean, using
this project's actual rank-8 lattice and compatible pinned mathlib APIs.
Source: https://github.com/math-inc/Sphere-Packing-Lean/blob/1e98fb493088948ca7bbf47d7faed49cc5b39fc4/SpherePacking/Dim24/Uniqueness/Rigidity/Classify/EvenUnimodular/ThetaAnalytic.lean
The external module and its imported dependency closure were not built here.
Local uniform convergence, holomorphy, cusp limit and explicit integer dual
basis certificates were added in this project.


Selected generic Poisson and radial Schwartz closure adapted from the same

The Gaussian profile/decay part of the rank-24 ThetaTransform.lean listed
in the source manifest was adapted to actual rank eight in E8ThetaSchwartz.
Original copyright/author headers are retained where provided.
Modifications: local import paths, visibility, pinned mathlib API adaptation,
explicit coercion/definitional-equality steps; dimension-eight specialization
and use of the existing Gaussian Fourier formula in the E8 application.
Local selected adaptations prove general lattice Poisson summation and the
actual E8 S law/modular form. The original rank-24 modules and the entire
upstream repository were not built. No sharp all-scale Gaussian minorant or
Riesz regularization theorem is supplied by this port.
